business_objective: Membangun ekosistem kedaulatan digital terfederasi di locomo.id yang mencakup gateway identitas (Mandeh.ID), portal wisata & reputasi (Mandeh.Online), platform akademik (HakCampus.id), jaringan kepemudaan (Tapak Pandeka), dan modul demokrasi warga (Smart-Citizen).

deployment.infrastructure: Laravel 13/11, Python FastAPI, PostgreSQL, pgvector, Ollama Local

hard_constraints: Stateless authentication via Mandeh.ID JWT tokens
User approval required before registering or syncing new projects
